verdict.line: You lose if you let Jax reach level 6 with Counter Strike (E) up and trade into his stun; you win if you force fights with Death's Grasp (E) before that, since it pulls him regardless of his stance.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser vs Jax sits at 48.1% over 133 games — genuinely even, but the shape flips hard at level 6. Jax's Counter Strike (E) only dodges basic attacks and reduces area damage; it never dodges Death's Grasp (E), so Mordekaiser's pull-Q burst is the one tool Jax structurally cannot avoid. Jax's solo-kill edge comes entirely from his level 6 all-in window, where Relentless Assault (R) stacking attack speed plus a rank-up Counter Strike stun turns extended trades into a stat check.

theirWindow.what: Jax can bait an auto with Empower (W), dodge your follow-up, then land the Counter Strike stun and chain Relentless Assault (R) attack speed. Do not extend a trade here — disengage or force it with a pull instead of autos.

yourWindow.what: Pull him in with Death's Grasp (E) into Obliterate (Q), which hits hardest on a single target. He has no answer to the pull itself, only reduced area damage from the follow-up Q.

start.why: 46.2% win rate over 104 games and the most picked start (60.8%) — the mana and regen let you spam Death's Grasp and Obliterate in extended pre-6 trades without running dry.

boots.why: 80.8% pick rate and the higher win rate of the two boots options — directly blunts Jax's Relentless Assault attack speed stacking and his Empowered autos.

core.why: Slow from Q and E makes it harder for Jax to reset with Leap Strike after a pull, and adds health for the trades he wins early.
Omnivamp turns your Indestructible-banked damage into real sustain against his sustained on-hit pattern.
Burn punishes Jax for standing in extended fights, which is exactly the fight state his kit wants to reach.

situational.when: jax rushes attack speed and starts out-dueling you through armor
you need more sustain to survive his level 6-8 all-in window
you want an active to force fights on your own cooldown timing

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks from repeated spell and auto hits in the E-Q trade pattern, and the healing it grants stacks with Indestructible's banked-damage shield for sustained duels rather than single burst trades.

summoners.why: 73.5% pick rate — Ignite punishes the early-lead window before level 6 and denies Jax's Equipment Mastery sustain. If you're consistently losing the level 6 all-in, Exhaust+Flash carries the higher win rate (57.1%) by directly neutering his Relentless Assault burst.

playing.title: Bait Counter Strike before all-in
playing.detail: Counter Strike only dodges basic attacks, not spells. Poke with Q first so Jax either wastes his stance on nothing or commits it early, then follow with the real trade.

playing.title: Pull with E, not autos
playing.detail: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in the area and cannot be dodged by his stance — use it to open trades instead of walking into auto range where he can bait and stun you.

playing.title: Track his Leap Strike cooldown
playing.detail: 17/14/11/8/5s cooldown on Q means once he's used it to engage or reposition, he has no gap-closer or escape until it resets — this is your window to punish.

playing.title: Bank damage into your shield
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage you deal and take. Trade freely pre-6, then consume the shield to heal before disengaging rather than walking away at low health.

playing.title: Save R to isolate, not to open
playing.detail: Realm of Death drags him alone into another dimension and steals his stats. Hold it for after his level 6 all-in fails, or to strip him out of a skirmish where Relentless Assault is snowballing.

playing.title: Back off right at level 6
playing.detail: His Counter Strike rank-up and Relentless Assault coming online simultaneously is the single biggest swing in the matchup — don't extend trades here until Steelcaps and your first item land.

playing.title: Don't skip armor
playing.detail: Plated Steelcaps into Thornmail if he's out-dueling you directly counters his on-hit and attack-speed scaling rather than trying to out-damage him through it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Jax will slowly regain control over lane as he reaches level 6. Purchase Plated Steelcaps, Bramble Vest, and other items that increase armor before closing in to deal damage.
